text:
emma: Quick qtr OKR check-in — going to capture shipped / slipped / next step across runtime, API, and console. Please respond with ONE line: shipped/slipped + owner + next step. I'll consolidate for the exec sync.

emma: Runtime: core perf kernels landed (canary), GPU memory improvements merged. API: throughput gating work partially done, some infra deps blocked. Console: UI rollout slipped due to dashboard redesign + analytics schema change.

raj: Runtime — shipped (canary). Owner: raj. Next step: run 48h canary, then promote. I have an open checklist: `tools/checklist/canary.md`.

lex: API — slipped. Owner: lex. Next step: unblock infra dep (VPC peering for dedicated test), pinging eng-infra. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/827 (waiting on env flag). @eng-infra can we get a test VPC?

sofia: Console — slipped. Owner: sofia. Next step: finalize dashboard wireframes + handoff to frontend. Design assets delayed by 3 days; moving ship date to next sprint.

maria: Cross-team dependency: telemetry schema change blocks console and api rollout. Owner: maria. Next step: propose stable schema by EOD, then create migration plan.

lex: CR ping — I need two reviewers on PR 827. @raj @sofia can you take a quick look at the runtime-safety bits? small diff, ~30 LOC.

raj: on it, will review in next 2 hours.

sofia: can skim tonight, but full UX review tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: prod v0.42.1 -> 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Includes runtime perf patch and API feature flag for throughput gating.

lex: If infra can't provide VPC before EOD, proposal: run API test in staging with constrained nodes and simulate network to validate throughput. Owner: lex. Next step: I'll draft test plan by 11:30 PT.

maria: I'll post proposed telemetry schema at https://confluence.redwood/telemetry/schema-draft by 10:30 PT. If accepted, migration scripts ready by Friday.

emma: Thanks all — consolidated view: runtime = shipped->promote after canary, API = slipped->workaround plan if VPC delayed, Console = slipped->new ship sprint. Action owners: raj(promote), lex(test plan + CR fixes), sofia(FE handoff), maria(schema). I'll send summary to exec + link this thread. :thumbsup:

lex: ack.

raj: ack, starting canary monitoring now. Logs: `kubectl logs -f pod/runtime-canary`

sofia: noted, will update design tracker and tag frontend PRs.

emma: closing loop — please update your task card with final owner & due date by EOD. If anything changes ping here.
